scientific_question: Does relative A/B-template dominance become stronger near clinical onset than during far pre-ictal time?
primary_statistic: per subject: median-seizure near |mean C_AB| minus median-seizure far |mean C_AB|; cohort: median across subjects
primary_null: exhaustive non-zero circular shifts per seizure, independent seizure draws within subject, then independent subject draws for the cohort median

caveats: Primary C_AB is an ungated relative A/B template contrast and is defined for all own-field 2-D subjects.

The within-shaft axis-present result is a sensitivity analysis, not the full-cohort inclusion rule.
